- WYR_KillDirectorGortash_Ceremony.json: You are attending Enver Gortash’s coronation as Archduke/Grand Duke in a tense council chamber; the scene opens slightly differently depending on whether the Steel Watchers are active and nearby. Gortash openly admits his role in the Absolute hoax, implicates the player in past plots, and orders (or expects) the player to kill Orin before he finishes the ceremony while Watchers and Ravengard oversee the rites. Off-screen the city is already unstable: the Steel Watch Foundry and its Neurocitor control hub link the Watchers into a single, dangerous network and the player may have previously meddled with that device or rescued frightened locals. You can try to attack or object, but with the Watchers and Gortash’s forces present any direct confrontation is extremely difficult and likely to end badly.
- LOW_BhaalTemple_InWorldAbduction_Nested.json: The scene follows Orin revealing that she’d been impersonating a member of the player’s camp (either in camp or on entering the Undercity), dropping the disguise to taunt you and threatening someone she’s taken from you: kill Gortash and bring her his Netherstone, or she will kill the abductee and send her assassins after you. Her demand ties directly to Bhaal’s promise and the Netherstones, and she even briefly assumes Gortash’s form while explaining the bargain. Linked Act III content points the player toward the Steel Watch Foundry / Lower City — including scenes about the Foundry’s control centre and a neural switchboard explosion — as the practical route to confront Gortash and claim his stone. If you are a Dark Urge player, Orin’s lines emphasize a blood‑shared rivalry and a more personal, vindictive relationship with you, making her taunts and the ultimatum feel intimate and historically rooted.
- WYR_GortashConfrontation_OM_KarlachAndGortashEncounter_AOM_OOM.json: Dialog with Gortash in his office.Possible outcomes:1. You visited Steel Foundry and the destroyed Control Centre - he attacks you.2. You visited Steel Foundry, didn't destroy the Control Centre, but someone activated Dead Man switch which destroyed Iron T hrone. He attacks you.3. You visited Iron Throne which caused the destruction of it. He tells you - "I warned you" and then attacks you.4. You didn't kill Orin.5. You killed Orin and you have both Netherstones.6. Fallback node which includes the case where you killed Orin, but didn't bring either of the netherstones.
- WYR_KillDirectorGortash_AD_AfterCeremony.json: Gortash has just been proclaimed Archduke and is moving quickly to consolidate power, with Duke Ravengard publicly urging the Flaming Fist to unite under his authority and bring the Steel Watch firmly under central command. Off‑screen the city is already tense: the Steel Watch and the Gondian–illithid Neurocitor at the Foundry (the neural switchboard that links every Watcher) are active, fragile, and the subject of factional scheming — recent events include attempts to decipher or disable that device and rescue operations tied to it. Several nobles (Portyr, Rugger, Lady Alia) are uneasy about surrendering traditional authorities, while Gortash’s rhetoric in this scene presses imprisonment and forced “loyalty” as necessary for security. Investigations and encounters elsewhere have also raised darker suspicions about Gortash’s past and illithid connections (including revelations about his family), feeding the distrust behind many of these exchanges.
